headline: US Sanctions Eight Canadian Currency Exchanges Over Ties to Iran
summary: The US Treasury Department imposed sanctions on eight Canadian currency-exchange firms, freezing their US assets to crack down on financial conduits linked to Iran.
why: US extraterritorial sanctions against Canadian financial entities disrupt cross-border remittance corridors and heighten compliance risks for North American banks.

impacts.name: Canadian Currency Exchange Sector
impacts.why: Eight Canadian exchange firms had US-held assets frozen under US Treasury sanctions.
